readings.moment: When the temple struck ten (watch showed four minutes to ten)
Going out into the street to smoke
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar
Faint quick bells heard from the master's window while the piano played
Hall clock had just struck eleven
Hall clock face showed two minutes past eleven, when he came in

durations: Four minutes: Bastien's watch read four minutes to ten when the temple struck ten, so it was four minutes behind the temple bell
Eight minutes: from going out into the street at 10:21 to lighting his cigar as the piano started at 10:29 (implied)
Thirteen minutes: from the piano starting at 10:29 to stopping at 10:42 (implied)
whereabouts: Bastien Girard came to the house for the year-end dinner, as he does every year
Bastien Girard was at the dinner table with Aurèle Monnier, where they quarrelled over the price of the repeater rights
Félix took part, a little, in the table discussion about the repeater
Dr Vauthier was at the dinner, with his cigars and his Latin
Aurèle Monnier was at the dinner table during the quarrel and then went back to his plate
After the temple struck ten, Bastien Girard sat on alone in the dining room with the brandy
Bastien Girard went out into the street at 10:21 to smoke
Bastien Girard stayed under the front windows of the house
Bastien Girard lit his cigar in the street as the piano started at 10:29
Bastien Girard came back into the house at 10:46
After coming back into the house, Bastien Girard went up to Félix in the library
